title: Minimum Unlocked Indices to Sort Nums
summary: nums contains only 1,2,3 and locked is binary. An adjacent swap i,i+1 is permitted only when nums[i]-nums[i+1]=1 and locked[i]=0. You may unlock an index by setting its flag to zero. Return the fewest unlocks allowing ascending sorting, or -1 if impossible. Locks belong to indices, not traveling values.
